title: Fast Flip! Token Tools
description: Quick, hotkey-driven token and tile tools. Flip tokens and tiles, mark players as AFK, show who is speaking with a speech bubble, and raise a hand to queue up a question. Hold a key to pick a token's wildcard image, or its Visage looks if the Visage module is installed, from a radial wheel.

recommends.reason: Adds a radial wheel for picking visages
